original_test_intent: Measure all required 1G unidirectional CPU/GPU and GPU/GPU transfer paths and verify each bandwidth exceeds the approved AMD minimum without topology or stability faults.
original_method: Build a trusted pinned TransferBench, validate the pair maps, collect the complete P2P first table and cpu.cfg results under approved iterations and compare every GB/s cell to its supplied threshold.
manual_activity: Operator supervises sustained load and interlocks; engineer supplies the bandwidth specification, resolves pair/topology anomalies and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Pinned TransferBench commit/binary/hash and build dependencies
ROCm/toolchain versions and exact CPU/GPU topology
Validated p2p and cpu.cfg required pair map
1G workload, warmup/iteration and per-pair minimum GB/s rules
Maintenance, cooling/power, timeout/abort/OOB and evidence plan
safety_requirements: Review/pin code and configuration before execution
Drain workloads and establish idle power/thermal baseline
Continuously enforce cooling, power, timeout and first-fault aborts
Stop on missing pair, hang, invalid table, peer/link/driver/thermal/power error
Preserve partial/full tables and return devices to idle; do not alter power policy
agent_execution_scope: Build/install only approved TransferBench and retain build provenance
Run exact P2P 1G and approved cpu.cfg 1G workloads
Parse every required unidirectional pair from correct outputs with units
Do not substitute another harness, invent limits, rerun indefinitely or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Resolve missing/low/asymmetric paths and platform errors

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a topology-addressed pair matrix with direction, transfer semantics, size, repetitions, GB/s, threshold and first-fault/platform context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducibility and interlocks while retaining the exact TransferBench coverage.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NUM_WARMUPS/NUM_ITERATIONS and thresholds are absent from Master, so performance acceptance cannot be inferred.

project_override_considerations: Project authority may approve a demonstrably equivalent pinned harness only with explicit pair/direction coverage mapping; it may not replace the first-table/cpu.cfg requirements by an aggregate score.
expected_evidence: Pinned source/binary hash, build logs and toolchain versions
CPU/GPU topology, peer-access and validated cpu.cfg pair map
Exact commands, iterations, exits, timestamps and complete P2P tables
Complete cpu.cfg output and per-required-pair GB/s/spec comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The lengthy procedure consistently targets TransferBench 1G unidirectional results and CPU-config remote-read paths; missing thresholds/config finalization are project inputs, not competing source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Benchmark, configuration and specs can be supplied; static review is complete while execution is approval-gated.

review_improvement: Restores literal direction- and pair-level TransferBench coverage and adds reproducible artifact, threshold and sustained-load controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: An aggregate bandwidth score can conceal one failed peer path. The source requires all permutations and specifically distinguishes P2P Local Read/Remote Write from CPU-config Remote Read/Local Write, so direction, endpoint and transfer semantics must be bound to each result. The second table is retained to prove parser orientation but is not this row's acceptance oracle.
